Description: Minute Book — AppSync + DynamoDB + S3 backend with Cognito group roles (Owners / Accountants).

UserPoolId.Description: Existing Cognito user pool id to authorize the API.

UserPoolClientId.Description: Existing user-pool app client id (public web client), for the Identity Pool.

CognitoRegion.Description: Region of the Cognito user pool.

  getOfficer(id: ID!): Officer

  getSignificantControlPerson(id: ID!): SignificantControlPerson @aws_auth(cognito_groups: ["Executives", "Admin", "Finance"])

  getShareTransfer(id: ID!): ShareTransfer
  listShareTransfers(corpId: ID!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): ShareTransferConnection
}

GraphQLApiUrl.Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint — put this in MB_APPSYNC_ENDPOINT / config.appsync.endpoint.

FilesBucketName.Description: S3 bucket for uploaded files + minute books — set as MB_S3_BUCKET.

IdentityPoolId.Description: Cognito Identity Pool id — set as MB_IDENTITY_POOL_ID.

Region.Description: Region the API is deployed in (for config.appsync.region).
